service.description: Read one sheet of a spreadsheet. With headerRow the first row names the columns and each row is a map by those names; without it each row is a list of the cells. A cell is text, a number (a whole number is a Long), a boolean, or a date as a Timestamp in the user's time zone; an empty cell is null, and a row of empty cells is skipped. The body is Rust (crates/moqui-core/src/service/spreadsheet.rs).

parameter.name: location
parameter.description: The resource location of the file, when contentBytes is not given.

parameter.name: sheetName
parameter.description: The sheet to read; else the one at sheetIndex.

parameter.name: maxRows
parameter.description: Stop after this many rows (not counting the header).

service.description: Calculate over a workbook: open an xlsx with formulas (the template), set input cells, evaluate it and return the cells asked for, and the calculated workbook when asked. A cell is named as in Excel: B2 on the first sheet, Inputs!B2 on another, and A1:C3 for a range to read. A text value is set as a person typing it would (=B2*2 is a formula, 12 a number), a number and a boolean as they are, and null clears the cell; a cell keeps its style. The engine is IronCalc (crates/moqui-core/src/workbook.rs): xlsx only, with about 500 Excel functions, and no charts, images, pivot tables or macros, which a workbook given back does not keep. The body is Rust (crates/moqui-core/src/service/spreadsheet_calc.rs).

parameter.name: location
parameter.description: The resource location of the xlsx, when contentBytes is not given.

parameter.name: cellValues
parameter.description: Cell to value, set in the map's order before the workbook is evaluated.

parameter.name: readCells
parameter.description: The cells and ranges to return, read after the evaluation.

parameter.name: outputLocation
parameter.description: Write the calculated workbook to this resource location.

parameter.name: returnBytes
parameter.description: Return the calculated workbook as contentBytes.

parameter.name: valueMap
parameter.description: Each of readCells to its value: text, a number (a whole number is a Long), a boolean or null; an error is its text (#DIV/0!). A range is a list of rows, each a list of its cells.

parameter.name: textMap
parameter.description: Each of readCells to its text as the cell's number format shows it; a range as a list of rows.

service.description: Store (or create) a record of entityName for each row of a sheet with a header row. A column sets the field its header names, or the field fieldMap gives for that header; a column that is not a field is not set, and an empty cell is not set. Each row goes through the entity auto service, so authorization and ECAs apply, in the caller's transaction; the first error stops the load. The body is Rust (crates/moqui-core/src/service/spreadsheet.rs).

parameter.name: fieldMap
parameter.description: Column header to entity field name.
